description: Main source file for a Flutter-based food delivery application, defining app initialization, navigation routes, and main UI components including home screen, category list, food items, and navigation logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring Bloc providers and application routes.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main home screen with drawer menu, app bar, and list of food items.

classes.name: ItemContainer
classes.description: Widget representing individual food item, with add-to-cart functionality.

classes.name: FirstHalf
classes.description: UI component with header, category list, and search bar.

classes.name: Items
classes.description: Widget displaying individual food item details including image, name, price, and hotel info.

classes.name: CategoryListItem
classes.description: UI component representing a food category with icon and availability count.

classes.name: CustomAppBar
classes.description: Custom top app bar with menu icon and cart item count, navigates to cart page upon tap.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes Flutter environment and runs MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds UI components for each widget class, such as MyApp, Home, ItemContainer, etc.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a food item to the cart via Bloc.

methods.name: removeFromList
methods.description: Removes a food item from the cart via Bloc.
